The food looks like a folded omelette on a plate roughly 26 cm across, which is about 400 px in the image. The omelette measures about 200 px long and 90 px wide, so roughly 13 cm by 6 cm. Its thickness is probably about 2.5 cm folded.

That gives a volume of about 13 × 6 × 2.5 ≈ 195 cm³. A folded shape is not a full rectangular block, so I reduce that to roughly 150 cm³. Omelette density is about 0.9 g/cm³, which gives about 135 g.

A typical omelette contains about 150 kcal per 100 g, including the oil used in cooking. That puts 135 g at roughly 200 kcal. A 2–3 egg omelette would weigh 120–150 g, which fits this estimate.
